_about: VR-owned player presets. The pinned runtime.json water.presets are not modified and stay the opponents' presets (games.opponentPresets). The session builds the player from the preset named in 'player'. A missing or malformed file fails the session start, like combat.vr.json.
_player: Why: docs/DECISIONS.md 2026-10-07 'v2 vision accepted' (docs/design/V2-VISION.md: 'The signatures need a VR-owned player preset (Mirror A, Tide Orb IV picked on the stones) in the overlay, because the pinned presets cannot be edited').

cassia._basedOn: The pinned games.referencePreset, Rotation: lines tide_orb, lash, mirror and branches lash B, mirror B, tide_orb B. Only the two branches below differ from it.
cassia._mirror: Why: docs/DECISIONS.md 2026-10-07 'v2 vision accepted', signature moments (V2-VISION.md wave 3): 'Mirror II = Reflection (a VR player preset)'. Rotation has B (Ripple). A is the pinned spells-water.csv row 'Reflection: passive while slotted: a perfect absorb reflects the projectile; only projectiles of tier <= own unlocked tier'.
cassia._tide_orb: Why: docs/DECISIONS.md 2026-10-07 'v2 vision accepted', signature moments: 'the Leviathan / Rain of Orbs pick at the first intermission'. B (Rain of Orbs) is Rotation's branch, so a player who never picks plays today's orb. The stones below can set A (Leviathan Orb) from Bout 2 on.

stonePick._branch: Tide Orb IV is the only tier with a branch on that line (spells-water.csv rows 6 and 7).
stonePick._afterBout: Why: DECISIONS 2026-10-07 'v2 vision accepted': 'the Leviathan / Rain of Orbs pick at the first intermission'. The intermission after Bout 1 (Tiro wave index 0). The pick applies from Bout 2 on.
stonePick._left: The left stone engraves Leviathan Orb (A). Labels are strings.json pick.tideOrb.A and pick.tideOrb.B; the centre stone is pick.continue and keeps the current branch.
stonePick._right: The right stone engraves Rain of Orbs (B).
stonePick._default: Rotation's branch. Kept when nothing is picked.
stonePick._timeoutS: Why: docs/design/V2-ROADMAP.md row 14, intermission choices on the stones are 'never blocking (20 s)', and the T20 card: 'if nothing is picked in 20 s the default stays and the run continues'. The hold to pick is teach.json offerHoldS (docs/campaign/04-vr-campaign-design.md section 3).
